official_sources.title: GDAL OGRGeometry WKB byte order and variant export
official_sources.finding: GDAL exportToWkb requires an explicit XDR or NDR byte order and an explicit legacy OGC or ISO SQL/MM WKB variant for higher-dimensional geometries.
official_sources.limitation: WKB encodes geometry coordinates and dimensionality but does not by itself bind the intended CRS, coordinate epoch, parcel identifier or normalization policy.

official_sources.title: GDAL geometry Normalize canonical-form operation
official_sources.finding: GDAL Normalize attempts to bring a geometry into normalized or canonical form and depends on the GEOS library.
official_sources.limitation: Normalize can fail when GEOS support is unavailable, and a normalization result must not silently replace the exact source geometry without before-and-after digests and topology checks.

official_sources.title: GDAL geometry coordinate precision model
official_sources.finding: GDAL records separate XY, Z and M coordinate resolutions and states that encoding precision has no direct relationship with physical accuracy.
official_sources.limitation: Unknown precision must remain unknown; selecting a precision grid can modify serialized coordinates and therefore changes a geometry digest.

official_sources.title: GDAL RFC 99 coordinate precision propagation and GeoPackage behavior
official_sources.finding: GDAL RFC 99 defines coordinate precision metadata and notes that GeoPackage can store the metadata without modifying coordinates unless explicit rounding is requested.
official_sources.limitation: A writer version or option change can alter whether coordinates are rounded; software version, options and pre/post geometry hashes must be retained.

official_sources.title: OGC GeoPackage geometry binary header and WKB payload
official_sources.finding: GeoPackageBinary stores magic, version, flags, byte order, srs_id and optional XY/Z/M envelope before the WKB geometry; stored WKB axis order is x,y with optional z and m.
official_sources.limitation: The GeoPackage srs_id is database-local and must be resolved through the exact spatial reference tables; envelope values are metadata and require recomputation checks.

official_sources.title: RFC 7946 GeoJSON ordering, CRS and precision semantics
official_sources.finding: RFC 7946 declares JSON object member order irrelevant, fixes GeoJSON coordinates to WGS 84 longitude-latitude semantics and warns that coordinate digit count is not an uncertainty statement.
official_sources.limitation: Raw GeoJSON text cannot be used as a stable digest without canonicalization, and transforming a project geometry to RFC 7946 changes coordinates and CRS semantics.

official_sources.title: RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme
official_sources.finding: JCS produces invariant UTF-8 JSON through I-JSON constraints, deterministic property sorting and strict primitive serialization for repeatable hashes and signatures.
official_sources.limitation: JCS canonicalizes JSON representation only; coordinate array ordering, ring normalization, CRS binding and geometry semantics must be fixed separately.

official_sources.title: SQLite atomic and serializable transaction guarantees
official_sources.finding: SQLite documents transactions as atomic, consistent, isolated and durable, including interruption by program, operating-system or power failure.
official_sources.limitation: Atomic commit prevents partial database state but cannot prove that geometry bytes, CRS metadata and digest were correct before the transaction.
